notes.title: Italian Localization & Passing 50 000 downloads
notes.content:
[h1]Hey guys![/h1] 

The Flood has passed [b]50 000 downloads [/b]today!
 I'm really happy that so many of you are enjoying the game and it's message.
Thank you for all your support and kind words.

Game now also offers [b]Italian Localization.[/b]
Thanks to Joanna Poznańska for her work!

[h1]I have also started a small discord server[/h1]
Feel free to stop by if you would like to hang out and see what other projects I'm currently working on. [url=https://discord.gg/SmaUjYH]Join Discord[/url]

Cheers ! ːsteamhappyː
- Ondrej

notes.title: Localization Update & Discord
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
I was working on localization update for the past few weeks.
[b]The Flood now also supports these languages:[/b]
[list]
[*]Chinese
[*]Japanese
[*]Russian
[*]German
[*]Spanish
[*]Turkish
[*]French
[*]Dutch
[*]Czech
[/list]
Big thanks to everyone who helped !    ːsteamhappyː

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]I have also started a small discord server[/h1]
Feel free to stop by if you would like to hang out and see what other projects I'm currently working on. [url=https://discord.gg/SmaUjYH] Join Discord Here [/url]

[b]Thank you for all your amazing support and have a nice day![/b]
-Ondrej
